newsitem.title: USA: IBS files action over nominating materials.
newsitem.headline: IBS files action over nominating materials.

text.p: IBS Financial Corp said Wednesday it filed a legal action against a group of shareholders, alleging they failed to disclose all required information at the time they ran a nominee for the board earlier this year.

Named in the action, filed in U.S. District Court for the District of New Jersey, are Lawrence Seidman, Richard Whitman, their related limited liability companies and partnerships and other members of their investor group.

"We're asking the court to require them to provide us with the identity of their investors, limited partners, and other that are supporting their nominee," IBS Chief Executive Joseph Ochman told Reuters in a telephone interview.
Ochman said the election had been scheduled for January but may be postponed due to the litigation.
The company said it is also asking the court to permit it to reject the group's nomination of Ernst Beier because of the alleged deficiencies in the nomination materials.
Seidman and Whitman could not be reached for comment.
